name: 维护资源计划 (43R)
description_en_html:
Overview

Resource scheduling provides you with insights into your maintenance workload and available capacities for current and upcoming maintenance activities. Use the apps for resource scheduling to check current and forecast work center utilization, build schedules, and determine required capacities before dispatching the scheduled work.

Key Process Flow

  • Analyze maintenance workload and capacities
  • Simulate and schedule maintenance work order operations
  • Track if maintenance is executed as scheduled

Business Benefits

  • Gain insights into current and forecast workloads
  • Identify due and overdue maintenance orders quickly and build an optimal schedule before dispatching maintenance order operations for execution
  • Optimize the use of maintenance resources
  • Control weekly maintenance workloads by adjusting the scope of your schedule and distribute the work evenly across your work centers
  • Reduce asset downtime and increase productivity
  • Group and schedule maintenance orders by asset, consider work that requires planned downtime, and identify relationships between order operations
description_zh_html:
概览

通过资源计划，您可以深入了解当前维护活动和未来维护活动的维护工作量和可用产能。使用资源计划应用检查当前和预测工作中心利用率、构建计划并在分派计划工作之前确定所需产能。

关键流程流

  • 分析维护工作量和产能
  • 模拟和计划维护工作订单工序
  • 跟踪维护是否按计划执行

业务优势

  • 深入了解当前和预测工作量
  • 快速确定到期和逾期维护订单，并在分派维护订单工序执行之前构建最佳计划
  • 优化维护资源的使用
  • 通过调整计划范围来控制每周维护工作量，并在工作中心之间平均分配工作
  • 减少资产停机时间，提高生产力
  • 按资产分组和计划维护订单，考虑需要计划停机时间的工作，并确定订单工序之间的关系

flows.name: Maintenance Resource Scheduling (43R)
flows.description:
Overview

Resource scheduling provides you with insights into your maintenance workload and available capacities for current and upcoming maintenance activities. Use the apps for resource scheduling to check current and forecasted work center utilization, build schedules, and determine required capacities before dispatching the scheduled work. Plan which people should carry out which maintenance operations, taking into account their availability and their function at the work center.
